name: Sweeping_Cross
display_help: You execute a sweeping right hook that can strike multiple targets in your frontal arc. Sweeping Cross deals High Smashing damage and can disorient foes. Sweeping Cross is a Finisher and resets your current Combo Level to 0. It will deal additional damage and will have a greater chance to disorient dependent upon the current Combo Level.  At Combo Level 3, Sweeping Cross will also have a chance to knock down the affected targets.  Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate
display_short_help: Melee (Cone), High DMG (Smash), Foe Disorient, Finisher
